papers.title: Tuning Alginate-Gelatin Bioink Properties by Varying Solvent and Their Impact on Stem Cell Behavior
papers.abstract: Bioink optimization is considered as one of main challenges in cell-laden 3D bioprinting. Alginate-Gelatin (Alg-Gel) hydrogel have been extensively used as bioink. However, its properties could be influenced by various parameters, and little is known about the evidence featuring the impact of solvent. Here we investigated four Alg-Gel bioink by varying solvent ionic strength (named B-1, B-2, B-3 and B-4). Mechanical properties and printability of bioink samples and their impacts on behaviors of encapsulated epidermal stem cells (ESCs) were tested. Bioink with increased ionic strength of solvent showed decreased stiffness and viscosity, and increased swelling and degradation by printability and mechanical property tests. Due to the increased swelling and degradation was associated with shape-maintenance of post-printing constructs, B-3 and B-4 were hardly observable after 14 days. Cellular behaviors were assessed through viability, proliferation, aggregation and differentiation tests. B-2 with optimal properties resulted in higher viability and proliferation of ESCs, and further facilitated cellular aggregation and lineage differentiation. We demonstrated that the solvent can be tuned by ionic strength to control the properties of Alg-Gel bioink and post-printing constructs, which represented a promising avenue for promotion of therapeutic stem cell behaviors in 3D bioprinting.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文未涉及AI或机器学习在生物打印中的应用，纯粹是生物墨水配方与性能的实验研究。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not embed AI/ML into any bioprinting workflow stage; it is a purely empirical study on solvent effects without computational modeling or autonomous decision-making.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究溶剂离子强度对海藻酸钠-明胶生物墨水性能的影响。
summary_zh.method: 配制四种不同离子强度溶剂的生物墨水，测试力学、打印性及干细胞行为。
summary_zh.result: 离子强度增大，刚度粘度降低，溶胀降解增加；B-2配方最优，细胞活性增殖高。
summary_zh.validation: 通过力学测试、打印实验和细胞实验验证性能差异。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of solvent ionic strength on the properties of alginate-gelatin bioink for 3D bioprinting.
summary_en.method: Four bioink formulations with varying solvent ionic strength were prepared and characterized for mechanical properties, printability, and encapsulated epidermal stem cell behavior.
summary_en.result: Increased ionic strength led to decreased stiffness and viscosity, increased swelling and degradation; formulation B-2 showed optimal properties with higher cell viability and proliferation.
summary_en.validation: Validation through mechanical testing, printability assessment, and in vitro cell assays (viability, proliferation, aggregation, differentiation).

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了全髋关节置换术后的肌肉电活动，与患者方向的髋关节植入物应力遮挡和微动分析无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not quantify implant stress shielding, micromotion, or bone-implant interface mechanics; it focuses solely on muscle EMG activity post-THA.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估直接前路全髋置换术后髋部肌肉的肌电活动模式。
summary_zh.method: 对接受直接前路THA的患者进行术后肌电测量，分析肌肉激活特征。
summary_zh.result: 发现某些髋部肌肉的激活模式与预期不同，可能影响术后康复。
summary_zh.validation: 通过临床肌电图数据进行验证，比较不同肌肉的激活水平。

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the electromyographic activity of hip muscles after total hip arthroplasty via the direct anterior approach.
summary_en.method: Postoperative EMG measurements were performed on patients undergoing direct anterior THA to analyze muscle activation patterns.
summary_en.result: Surprising activation patterns were observed in certain hip muscles, which may affect rehabilitation strategies.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed using clinical EMG data from patients, comparing activation levels across muscles.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究LED散热器的选择性激光熔化制造与热性能验证，与生物医学植入物的应力屏蔽、疲劳或骨整合方向完全无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on thermal management of LED heat sinks via SLM, with no biomedical context, no implant mechanics, no osseointegration, and no fatigue testing of biomedical materials.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究LED散热器的散热性能，优化SLM制造工艺。
summary_zh.method: 通过数值模拟和实验验证，分析SLM制造的散热器热性能。
summary_zh.result: 验证了数值模型的准确性，并展示了SLM散热器的有效性。
summary_zh.validation: 实验测量散热器温度分布，与仿真结果对比。

summary_en.motivation: To optimize the thermal performance of heat sinks for compact LED downlights fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Numerical simulation combined with experimental validation to evaluate heat sink thermal behavior.
summary_en.result: Simulation results matched experimental measurements, confirming the effectiveness of SLM-manufactured heat sinks.
summary_en.validation: Experimental temperature measurements were compared with simulation predictions.

papers.title: Biofabrication of Three-Dimensional Tissue-Engineered Vascular Constructs
papers.abstract: Organ transplantation has been successfully developed to save numerous patient lives in the last several decades. However, its limitations are becoming more and more conspicuous, such as immune rejection, and particularly organ donor shortage. For example, U.S. Department of Health & Human Services reports that around 22 people die each day due to organ donor shortage. Fortunately, organ printing offers a great potential for the fabrication of three-dimensional (3D) living tissues and organs based on precise layer-by-layer deposition using various tissue spheroids as building blocks. The fabricated tissues and organs are envisioned to be used for the replacement of damaged or injured human organs, providing a promising solution to the challenge of organ donor shortage. Vascularization has been widely recognized as a main technological barrier for building thick tissues and organs.

llm.relevance_to_user: 此论文未涉及AI技术，与AI生物打印研究方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: No AI or machine learning methodology is proposed or used; it is a general review of bioprinting for vascular constructs.

summary_zh.motivation: 器官移植供体短缺，需生物打印技术制造替代组织。
summary_zh.method: 使用组织球体作为构建单元进行逐层沉积。
summary_zh.result: 血管化是制造厚组织器官的主要技术障碍。
summary_zh.validation: 未涉及实验验证，为综述性论文。

summary_en.motivation: Organ donor shortage motivates the development of 3D bioprinting for fabricating living tissues and organs.
summary_en.method: The review discusses layer-by-layer deposition of tissue spheroids as building blocks for organ printing.
summary_en.result: Vascularization is identified as the main technological barrier for constructing thick tissues and organs.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation; it is a perspective/review paper.
